name: end-refusal-e2e-post-abort-read
body: Two limits. (1) The post-abort visibility arm reads the rebuilt index through `apg query` with no live session, which is only distinguishable from a query-side rebuild because the `apg session: aborted` stderr probe already pins the abort's own rebuild succeeded; upgrade when phase 4 makes query's reclaim-and-rebuild unconditional, and re-check that a clean, shape-compatible database still takes the direct read rather than a rebuild. (2) The recall arm's one-commit count covers only the single pending row it saves; the full dirty-set delta contract belongs to the artifacts-side save test.
